notes_frame5: Fifth continuation frame added 26 new unique-DOI findings (130 -> 156). All 26 sourced from API responses (PubMed get_article_metadata abstracts + Europe PMC resultType=core verbatim abstracts; DOIs from search results only); all text_access=abstract_only with clean verbatim abstract source sentences. Threads worked: (1) research culture/wellbeing -> EMCA workplace-culture survey (89.5% overtime, 54.8% burnout, n=284), US postdoc COVID survey, Montenegro workaholism-burnout network (n=131); (2) narrative CV / assessment reform -> Stanford rigor/repro/transparency CV template, temporal-autonomy focus groups (172 researchers, 7 countries), funder narrative-CV scoping review, narrative-CV workshop report; (3) QRP/integrity interventions -> KEMRI institution-wide RI training, Uganda faculty ethics-training association (aOR 0.27), graduate authorship-training RCT (n=185); (4) data-sharing incentives/credit -> drivers/inhibitors SR (32 studies), Ecuador OS-adoption (OR 0.72 journal-metrics vs 1.65 institutional support, n~418), credit-for-data-sharing-platforms interviews (n=17); (5) authorship inflation/team science -> INAP ethical analysis, rise of the middle author (WoS 1980-2015), strategic co-authorship synthesis; (6) metascience -> peer-review discordance meta-research (74.8%/85.8% first-round, n=16006), predicting-replicability structured elicitation (acc 0.57/0.58), OS-interventions scoping review (15 of 105 measured effect directly), reproducibility-barriers interviews (n=60); (7) metric gaming & fraud/paper mills -> metrics-against-gamed-metrics review, fight-fake-papers review, forensic red-flagging (~5.8% biomedical fakes), ML cancer paper-mill screening (9.87% of 2.6M flagged), retracted-AI-papers bibliometric (764 retractions, 667 in 2023), article-level-vs-journal-level recognition (Arabi, 10-20%). Added 1 new CONFLICT (self-admitted fabrication ~1.97% [10.1371/journal.pone.0005738] vs detection-based ~5.8% [10.1007/s00210-025-04275-9]) and 1 figure_data (fabrication/fraud-prevalence estimates by method: self-report 1.97% vs Bayesian-detection 5.8% vs ML-flagged 9.87%). Snowball round 4 (newest forward-citers of pbio.2004089) surfaced 2026 Scientometrics/Research Evaluation/LIS Research candidates NOT indexed in Europe PMC; no retrievable verbatim text -> excluded per integrity and logged. New-unique rate stayed well above 2% across all passes; cumulative unique (156) still below 200 floor -> further continuation required.
notes_frame4: Fourth continuation frame added 27 new unique-DOI findings (103 -> 130). All 27 sourced from API responses (PubMed get_article_metadata abstracts; DOIs verified via PubMed search + convert_article_ids; Europe PMC CITED-sort for discovery of the DORA/responsible-metrics cluster). All 27 marked text_access=abstract_only with clean verbatim abstract source sentences (avoided sentences containing HTML entities such as nbsp/thin-space/>= for clean substring matching). Threads worked: (1) DORA/Leiden responsible-metrics -> 12 findings (misalignment-of-incentives PNAS reform, in-defense-of-quantitative-metrics Ioannidis, DORA-compliant Delphi measures, mis-measuring-universities rankings, Relative Citation Ratio, SCOPE framework, RIPP funder integrity plan, equitable-open-research Delphi, faculty define quality/prestige/impact, two-part rethinking-success multi-actor study, failure-of-success synthesis); (2) salami/duplicate publication journal policies (only 13% cover both) + citation misuse/distortion (~10% biomedical citations strongly inaccurate); (3) SPIN in abstracts of nonsignificant RCTs -> 6 findings replicated across specialties (JAMA-foundational 58.3%, urology 76%, bariatric 55%, vascular, analgesic ACTTION, emergency-medicine 44.3% with industry-funding OR 3.4); (4) research waste/value -> EViR Funders' Forum ten Guiding Principles + JLA priority-setting; (5) preprint concordance -> medRxiv-journal pairs 86.4% concordant sample sizes, 96.2% concordant interpretations; (6) publication pressure/QRP culture -> Hungarian PPQr survey, Amsterdam research-misbehavior variance (climate 22%), NSF Fellows misconduct rates, QRP organisational-culture determinants. Added 1 new CONFLICT (pro-quantitative-metrics Ioannidis 10.1371/journal.pbio.3002408 vs anti-ranking mis-measuring-universities 10.3389/frma.2021.680023) and 1 figure_data (spin-in-abstracts prevalence across 4 specialties). Note: PubMed auto-translation over-ANDed multi-term meta-science queries (preprint/registered-reports/replication-incentives queries returned 0 or clinical-trial-protocol noise); Europe PMC relevance-sort broke WebFetch (returned only API version); registered-reports PubMed query mistranslated to clinical-trial registrations. New-unique rate stayed well above 2% (frame yield ~24 relevant per ~120 records examined). Cumulative unique (130) still below 200 floor -> further continuation required.
